memoryRule: a three-mark relation is geometry-neutral until its third mark; closure makes the chosen trio lose ink while an unchosen stamp becomes a false imprint, another becomes a vacancy, and a third carries a pressure ridge
interactionRule: pointer or touch taps three distinct stamps; Enter, Space, and the misread control use deterministic pressure chords; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: browser-native DOM/CSS accordion page, Canvas pressure plate, and WebGL relief -> deterministic p5.js Canvas 2D pressure misprint of uneven geometric stamps
compositionRupture: crooked page, singular plate, and faceted body -> skewed print board with distributed stamps, displaced false imprint, and negative vacancy
encounterRupture: scroll/swipe page turn, pressure stroke, and dwell on a facet -> discrete three-mark chord whose third tap closes a non-local material mistake
temporalRupture: false pagination, remote pressure plate, and held reconstruction -> staged relation memory in which closure hardens an incorrect material allocation
mediumRupture: browser DOM/CSS, Canvas 2D/WebGL raster geometry -> p5.js 1.11.3 Canvas 2D as the produced print medium
changedRule: A three-mark pressure chord does not remain where it was offered. Its closure makes the selected stamps lose ink and produces a false imprint, vacancy, and pressure ridge at unchosen stamps.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is a skewed print of thirteen uneven stamps. A committed chord changes actual raster geometry away from the selected marks; four false allocations remain visible and later chords inherit them.
falsifier: Delete if the selected trio is the answer, if the chord is a decorative trace, if remote roles are only colour/readout, if the print reads as a generic grid or brush demo, if later chords reset, or if exact lifting fails.
deletionCondition: Delete v037 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish the pressure misprint from the preceding page, plate, or relief grammars, or if the material error is not visibly produced away from the offer.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
